summary: PROPOSED. D11 turns the draft 27-node chain (research/nuclear-geology-research-brief.md section 4) into 21 new nodes plus its 6 owned nodes, keeping science, application and realization apart. Science: radioactivity -> radiation_detection -> nuclear_physics (which now carries the discovery of fission and the mass-energy edge to relativity) -> nuclear_fission, narrowed to the controlled chain reaction (378,480 -> 267,620 RP). Application: four reactor families as alternative routes (graphite and heavy water run on natural uranium; light water needs enrichment; fast breeders need reprocessing) feeding nuclear_power, renamed from the realized 'Nuclear power station' to 'Nuclear power-plant engineering'; radioactive ore processing, enrichment, reprocessing, geological disposal, radioisotope production; radiation protection, radiotherapy and nuclear medicine in the medicine subtree. Weapons: the weapon capability leaves nuclear_fission for a new fission_weapon reached by enrichment OR reprocessing (the two dual-use steps); thermonuclear follows it; controlled fusion no longer requires weapons (magnetic route via superconductivity_applied, inertial route via thermonuclear AND laser). Frozen-Spine honesty (civ-sim-architecture-v3-outline.md:137, :154): weapons realize only as the modern-era deterrence abstraction (M10+, not M7/M8); every civil-nuclear node is knowledge-only and any civil-nuclear mechanic would need a contradiction report to the Director (OPEN DECISION); the radiation-medicine nodes name M9 society as a medical consumer. Geology path: ore_prospecting (A3 trunk, tin-ore identification live in M6 under fog) -> mineralogy -> stratigraphy -> geophysical and radiometric prospecting, plus an identification contract (exposed and concealed classes) for the fog lane covering copper, tin, iron ore, coal, petroleum, salt, potash, phosphate, nitrate, sulphur, bauxite, argentiferous galena, pozzolana and uranium; proving and the survey institution are IMPLEMENTATION DEFERRED (M11+). Draft nodes merged or rejected: assaying (D02's new cupellation carries fire assay), geological_survey (an institution of stratigraphy), fuel_fabrication (folded into the reactor families), centrifuge_enrichment (a plant variant), borehole drilling (D02's percussion_drilling). Lane workload 815,750 -> 2,411,330 RP (+1,595,580); the fission split totals 521,370 vs 378,480 RP.

Magnetic route: the tokamak (Sakharov and Tamm, about 1950-51) and the stellarator (Spitzer, 1951) came from plasma physics and were declassified around the 1958 Geneva conference [search: PPPL histories]; superconducting magnets (the current edge, kept) are what reactor-scale confinement needs. No nuclear-science node (radioactivity, radiation_detection, nuclear_physics, nuclear_fission, reactors, enrichment) carries an identification grant.

Identification is gated only where recognising the material as a resource needs knowledge - a non-obvious mineral (cassiterite, bauxite, phosphate, potash, caliche, uranium minerals) or a non-obvious value (green copper minerals as ore, galena as silver ore, volcanic ash as pozzolana). Self-evident materials (outcropping coal, oil and bitumen seeps, salt, native sulphur, ochre-red iron ore) are identified on observation without research: research must not hide what any observer sees (D-045 baseline; F-46).
A deposit a settlement already works is known by use; baseline extraction is never hidden.
